data.exact_reserve_text: The Directors consider that the provisions for gross claims and related reinsurance recoveries are fairly stated on the basis of the information currently available to them. However, the ultimate liability will vary as a result of subsequent information and events and this may result in significant adjustments to the amounts provided.

named_events.loss_description: Non-adjusting post balance sheet California wildfire event in early January 2025 with net exposure in the range of $46m-$79m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding opened at $1,141.38m (USD). Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates no material prior-year reserve movement (net prior-year development of $0.0m), i.e. broadly flat prior-year development. The reserving outlook notes uncertainty from economic and social inflation, and from geopolitical events which could delay claims reporting; these are the principal drivers monitored. No specific prior-year reserve deterioration or release is quantified in the notes; a material post-balance-sheet California wildfire (Jan 2025) is disclosed as non-adjusting with a net exposure range.
raw_causal_phrases: future economic and social inflation, more material due to the ongoing heightened inflation environment; and ongoing conflicts and political tensions that require detailed monitoring of potential exposures and for which claims reporting may be delayed.
The Directors consider that the provisions for gross claims and related reinsurance recoveries are fairly stated on the basis of the information currently available to them.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross, $000) and yields a net PYD of $0.0m. There is no explicit labelled 'movement in prior year's provision' gross figure in the notes. A line 'Provision in respect of prior years 49,510' appears in the triangle section but its presentation was ambiguous and was not used as the authoritative prior-year movement. All extracted monetary tables are reported in the underlying currency and units (USD, amounts shown in the accounts are in $000).
